source.title: Order No. 1395 of 2007 on the electronic Lovtidende, § 1(2): Civilstyrelsen publishes the official gazettes Lovtidende and Ministerialtidende on lovtidende.dk
Order No. 1267 of 2025, § 2: applications to the Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI) go through its digital service on www.nyidanmark.dk
Order No. 1395 of 2007 on the electronic Lovtidende, § 1(3): Civilstyrelsen runs the shared system for rules published on lovtidende.dk and retsinformation.dk
